steps.code:
# I need to get all downloaded songs to have a complete set of downloaded song IDs. Let me fetch all pages.
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
downloaded_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_downloaded_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    for song in page:
        downloaded_song_ids.add(song["song_id"])
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total downloaded songs: {len(downloaded_song_ids)}")
print(downloaded_song_ids)

steps.code:
# The current song (322) is not downloaded. I'll loop: check current song, if not downloaded, go to next. I'll limit iterations to the queue length to avoid infinite loops.
max_iterations = len(queue)
for i in range(max_iterations):
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_id = current["song_id"]
    print(f"Iteration {i}: Current song_id={current_id}, title='{current['title']}'")
    if current_id in downloaded_song_ids:
        print(f"Reached downloaded song: {current['title']}")
        break
    apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
else:
    print("No downloaded song found in queue cycle")
